notes.title: FREE HD 4K Remaster update is live!
notes.content:
Hello puzzle solvers,

The Mad Experiments series is a bit more than 5 years old and the games are still quite popular, so I figured out it was time to give tons of love to [b]Mad Experiments 1 and 2.[/b] We upgraded visuals, controls, and added tons of small quality-of-life improvements!

Here's the list of what changed:
[list]
[*] All the textures of the game are now in 4K
[*] Re-vamped controls with keyboard + mouse
[*] Improved gameplay and removed motion sickness
[*] Improved clue system in Mad Experiments 1
[*] Fix many glitches and viausl artefacts in all rooms
[*] Co-op games should now be more stable
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!
Report issues via Steam Discussions or our support portal.

Join our Discord or drop a message in Steam's forums if you want to have a chat with us! :)

notes.title: Chapter 2 is available now!
notes.content:
[h1]Chapter 2 is now in the game, for free![/h1]

[previewyoutube=WzUHjpbGsQU;full][/previewyoutube]


Explore this mystical room where you are trying to restore your memory, with the help of Hildegarde. New atmosphere, new puzzles, and a new chapter of the story of Hildegarde, all for free!

This room is way more mystical and mysterious than the previous one. It feels like you are outside, but actually, you are in your character's head. With the help of a new character, restore your memory to wake up and escape!
I went with an atmosphere drastically different from the previous one, bright and peaceful, with a strong connection to Nature. I hope you will enjoy!


[h2]Thank you x1000 for your tremendous support![/h2]
Without you, this adventure would not be possible! Shoutout to everyone who sent their feedback, reported bugs, wrote reviews and helped me to grow on social media! You are awesome and I'm glad to have you by my side <3

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
I will add things that I did not have the time to add before the release of Chapter 2:
 - In the coming days, the versions for Mac and Linux will be out!
 - New languages: Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Portuguese, German and Polish!
 - New secrets & achievements for both rooms
 - Bugfixes and comfort features

[h3]Enough talking, more thinking! Let's get in there and kick some as...puzzles! :)[/h3]

The large majority of you are having a smooth ride but on some specific occasions, few bugs appeared.

[h3][b]Know Issues on macOS & Linux[/b][/h3]
The cursor could be off-centered, which makes picking up objects and interacting a pain.

Thank you for your support and your patience!

Stay safe and sharp!

notes.title: Patch notes 1.26 to 1.37
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Sorry I usually share the patch notes on Discord but I've forgot to post them here.
I will do my best to post the updates as soon as their release!

Patch notes: 1.26 to 1.37
- Settings: Added FoV in visual settings menu
- Settings: You can now choose to Hold or Press to crouch
- New ambient music system
- 1 big new soundtrack + 3 new small tracks that play randomly in the room
- A bunch of sound effects on every objects of the room
- Settings: the sliders should now work properly when you have a controller plugged to your computer
- Updated feedback form
- Player moves a bit faster
- Various optimizations of the main menu and room
- Networking improvements
- Various fixes and improvements

For the latest, join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/mFCWNmb

The making of Room 2 is going well, along with adding a few surprise for release in Early Access ;)
